clues: This is the fifth largest city in El Salvador. It is a department capital in the south-east of the country.
Most of the year here is very hot and humid. The close Pacific Ocean helps keep the air damp and warm.
Big quakes hit this city in February two thousand one. They hurt the town a lot and left deep marks.
Hurricane Mitch hit this town too in nineteen ninety eight. It came a few years before the big quakes.
The main Catholic church stands in a park at the town center. It sits right next to the town hall and a cinema.
